response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT timespan, record_count, record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT timespan, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan;

assumptions.assumption: Time-in-force values with no matched risk/margin records are omitted from the average; NULL is not treated as a time-in-force value.

alternatives.interpretation: Include all four documented time-in-force values, including those with zero matched records, when calculating the average share.
alternatives.sql: WITH time_in_force(timespan) AS (VALUES ('IOC'), ('GTC'), ('GTD'), ('FOK')), counts AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault WHERE o.timespan IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT t.timespan, COALESCE(c.record_count, 0) AS record_count, COALESCE(c.record_count, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(c.record_count, 0)) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM time_in_force AS t LEFT JOIN counts AS c ON c.timespan = t.timespan) SELECT timespan, record_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS difference_from_average_share FROM shares ORDER BY timespan;
